milestones.label: Independence
milestones.description: India gains independence from British rule on August 15, 1947. The country is partitioned into India and Pakistan.

milestones.label: Republic
milestones.description: India becomes a republic on January 26, 1950. The Constitution of India comes into effect.
events: Dr. Rajendra Prasad becomes first President

milestones.label: States Reorganisation
milestones.description: States Reorganisation Act reorganises Indian states along linguistic lines.

milestones.label: Bombay Split
milestones.description: Bombay State is divided into Maharashtra and Gujarat on May 1, 1960.

milestones.label: Bangladesh War
milestones.description: India-Pakistan war leads to creation of Bangladesh. Himachal Pradesh becomes a full state.

milestones.label: New States
milestones.description: Three new states carved out — Chhattisgarh, Jharkhand, and Uttarakhand.

milestones.label: Telangana
milestones.description: Telangana is carved out of Andhra Pradesh, becoming India's 29th state.

milestones.label: J&K Reorganisation
milestones.description: Jammu & Kashmir is reorganised into two Union Territories — J&K and Ladakh.

milestones.label: Present
milestones.description: India today has 28 states and 8 Union Territories.
